text: Hide and seek, Dadda. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Gip from a stool. <break time="0.8s" /> And before I could stop them. <break time="0.8s" /> The shopman brought a big drum. <break time="0.8s" /> Down over him. <break time="0.8s" /> I shouted at him. <break time="0.8s" /> To take it off. <break time="0.8s" /> But when he lifted it. <break time="0.8s" /> The drum was empty. <break time="0.8s" /> And the stool was empty too. <break time="0.8s" /> There is no deception, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> He said once again. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he slipped quickly away. <break time="0.8s" /> Through a dark doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> I leaped after him. <break time="0.8s" /> And the next moment. <break time="0.8s" /> I bumped into a working man. <break time="0.8s" /> In the bright daylight of Regent Street. <break time="0.8s" /> It was Gip himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Who stood beside me. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding four parcels. <break time="0.8s" /> And he quietly took hold of my finger again. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the shop had been I saw only a plain pillar. <break time="0.8s" /> Between a picture shop. <break time="0.8s" /> And a window full of baby chicks. <break time="0.8s" /> In the cab. <break time="0.8s" /> I threw away a glass ball. <break time="0.8s" /> That I found in my pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> And Gip said at last. <break time="0.8s" /> Dadda, that was a proper shop. <break time="0.8s" /> At home the parcels held three boxes. <break time="0.8s" /> Of ordinary lead soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> And a white kitten. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was very much alive. <break time="0.8s" /> Months later. <break time="0.8s" /> Gip told me that his soldiers did march by themselves. <break time="0.8s" /> Whenever he said the word. <break time="0.8s" /> But I have never seen them move. <break time="0.8s" /> I have never found that shop again. <break time="0.8s" /> But I suppose. <break time="0.8s" /> The bill will come someday. <break time="0.8s" /> Since they know Gips name and address.
